<thought>Search the template catalog for a Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons (HWE) reaction template that breaks a C‑P bond and a C‑O bond and forms a C=C double bond.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["phosphonate", "ester"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkene"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C=C"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-P", "C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
